name: sivpro-backend
description: Backend de S.I.V.PRO - subida de archivos a Cloudinary

scripts.typecheck: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; const walk = (d) => fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((e) => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d, e.name)) : (e.name.endsWith('.js') ? [path.join(d, e.name)] : [])); const files = walk('src'); files.forEach((f) => execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' })); console.log('Typecheck OK: ' + files.length + ' archivos revisados.');"
